title: Insulin Pump Program Supply Billing Units and Cash Price List
content:
Billing units, per-model supply items and cash prices for the supplies of the Insulin Pump Program.

## Supply allowances by tier

| Tier | Days of supply per A4224 unit | Cartridges or reservoirs per 30 days | A4239 units per 30 days (MiniMed 780G) | Physical sensors per 30 days (MiniMed 780G) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Insulin Pump Self-Pay Program | 7 | 10 | 1 | 5 |
| Insulin Pump Commercial HMO Program | 7 | 10 | 1 | 5 |
| Insulin Pump Commercial PPO Program | 7 | 15 | 1 | 5 |
| Insulin Pump Medicare Advantage Program | 7 | 10 | 1 | 5 |
| Insulin Pump Original Medicare Program | 7 | 10 | 1 | 5 |
| Insulin Pump Medicaid Program | 7 | 10 | 1 | 5 |

## Cartridge or reservoir item by pump model (all tiers)

| Pump model | Item |
|---|---|
| Tandem t:slim X2 | A4225 cartridge |
| Tandem Mobi | A4225 cartridge |
| MiniMed 780G | A4232 reservoir |
| Beta Bionics iLet | A4225 cartridge |

## Larkfield cash price per billing unit (all tiers)

| Item | Billing unit | Cash price |
|---|---|---|
| A4224 | one week of infusion catheter supplies | $38.40 |
| A4225 | one cartridge | $6.85 |
| A4232 | one reservoir | $7.10 |
| A4239 | one 30-day sensor supply allowance for a pump-integrated sensor | $395.00 |

## Definitions

- **Days of supply per A4224 unit** — one unit is one week of infusion catheter supplies; a shipment's A4224 units are its supply days divided by this figure, rounded up.
- **Cartridges or reservoirs per 30 days** — the cartridges or reservoirs covered per 30 days of supply.
- **A4239 units per 30 days** — the A4239 billing units per 30 days of supply for a pump-integrated sensor (MiniMed 780G only).
- **Physical sensors per 30 days** — the physical pump-integrated sensors shipped per 30 days of supply for a MiniMed 780G program.

*Worked example (hypothetical shipment):* a 90-day infusion-set shipment is 90 days divided by 7, which is 12.86, rounded up to 13 A4224 units; a 30-day shipment is 4.29, rounded up to 5 units. A 90-day MiniMed 780G sensor shipment is 3 A4239 units and 15 physical sensors.
